messages:
alex.p: Heads-up — we need to lock sequencing for the Q3 routing/latency initiative. Product asks: customer-driven SLA (99.9), canary in prod, and an opt-in private deploy path for 3 pilot customers. Who owns the gating checklist?
maya: I can own the checklist but need commitments from runtime/infra/security on items and lead times. Main concerns: canary capacity, perf regression detection, and security signoff window.
ryan_runtime: For canary perf tests we'll need 4x A100-equivalent GPUs for 48 hours + the ability to run a continuous 1% traffic experiment. Runtime needs model variant pinning and bypass fallback if KV cache mismatch occurs.
priya_infra: Reserving GPUs is fine but we need a month lead for Dedicated pool quota request unless we use burst seats. Also need network egress plan for private pilots (VPC peering + transient NAT).
sam_security: Security requires a scoped threat model and SSO/KMS integration checklist before any private deploy. If customers are regulated we need a minimal audit log retention policy (30d) and a risk signoff. Can we get that by next Wed?
lucy_sre: Ops needs observability hooks instrumented: per-route latency, token-level cost metrics, and alert thresholds for 95/99p latency. Also outline rollback criteria for the canary — what counts as an unacceptable regression.
jason_product: Proposed rollout sequence: 1) internal dogfooding 2) 1% canary (non-critical customers) 3) private pilot (3 customers) 4) general availability. Target ship-window is 6 weeks.
maya: That sequence works. Open questions: timeline for security signoff, infra quota lead time, and runtime changes for model pinning. If any >2 weeks, we should push ship-window.
ryan_runtime: Model pinning work is ~5 dev-days + 2 testing days. We can do a lightweight pinning (version tag + fallback) for the canary; full rollback orchestration is another sprint.
priya_infra: Quota request: submit ticket to infra-allocations today to try for next-week approval. If not approved, we'll use burst seats with a cost bump. I'll post the ticket ID here.
sam_security: I can do an initial threat-model draft in 3 days, full signoff in 9 business days assuming no major findings. If customers require HSM integration that's an extra 2 weeks.
lucy_sre: Rollback criteria proposal: any sustained 2x increase in p99 latency, error rate >0.5% over baseline for 15m, or token-quality regression flagged by evals. If triggered, immediate rollback to previous model variant and throttle traffic to 0.1%.
maya: OK — action items: (A) ryan: lightweight pinning & canary fallback (5d) (B) priya: quota ticket + private pilot networking (ASAP) (C) sam: threat model draft (3d) (D) lucy: alert thresholds + runbook stub (4d) (E) alex/jason: coordinate customer opt-ins + legal NDAs. Can we confirm owners by EOD?
ryan_runtime: Confirmed. I'll add a short README with `pinning.md` and a canary runbook snippet: ````
# canary-run
traffic: 1%
monitor: p95/p99/err
fallback: model_tag:stable
````
priya_infra: Submitted infra-allocations ticket: INF-4821. Requested 4x A100-equivalent GPUs for 48h window next Tue. Also added VPC peering steps to the private-pilot doc.
sam_security: Draft threat model posted: <link:docs/internal/threats/1988887776>. Marked two high-risk items: audit retention and auth scope. Need input from legal for NDAs.
lucy_sre: Added canary alert rules to the shared dashboard and a runbook stub (short): if canary alert fires, follow rollback checklist -> notify #oncall -> engage runtime to pin fallback.
jason_product: I'll coordinate customer invites. Need a short one-pager we can send to pilots — can someone create that? (1 page, risks, SLA, support hours)
alex.p: Looks good. Decision points for leadership: 1) accept 6-week ship-window 2) approve burst-seat budget for worst-case 3) signoff SLA wording. I'll put this on Friday leadership sync.
maya: Thx — I'll circulate the consolidated checklist and a Gantt stub by tomorrow. If anyone hits a blocker, flag in this thread and ping me directly. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary pipeline created by ryan_runtime. Pipeline id: canary-1988887776. No runs yet.
maya: Final ask — can we get an explicit fallback policy documented (who aborts canary, who authorizes rollback) before canary start? We need assignment for escalation.
ryan_runtime: Assign escalation: runtime-oncall for first 30m, then eng-sre/incident commander. I'll add names to the runbook.
maya: Great. Thanks everyone — this unblocks my planning. I'll update the roadmap doc after leadership sync.
